sloka: तमेवमुक्त्वा सङ्कृद्धो मालामुत्क्षिप्य काञ्चनीम् ।पित्रा दत्तां महेन्द्रेण युद्धाय व्यवतिष्ठत ॥४-११-३९॥।।
transliteration: tamevamuktvā saṅkṛddho mālāmutkṣipya kāñcanīm ।pitrā dattāṁ mahendreṇa yuddhāya vyavatiṣṭhata ॥4-11-39॥।।

translations.english: 'Having addressed thus in a rage, Vali removed the golden garland gifted by Indra, his father, and stood ready for the combat.
